Overview

San Lorenzo is a city in CE with a population of 250,000. A suburb of Asunción, home to the National University of Asunción and a growing commercial center. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
